timing: retrospective specification of previously generated candidate

sourceFacts.fact: An XY child inherits their X chromosome from their mother.
With a carrier mother and unaffected father, an X-linked recessive allele may produce an affected son or a carrier daughter.

invariants: Exactly 2x2 cells with correct superscript A/a and labels.
No claim carrier daughters can never have symptoms.
expectedLabels: Each child inherits one maternal X
layoutSpecification: Precise hand-painted 2x2 Punnett square. Title 'X-linked recessive inheritance'. Subtitle 'Carrier mother × unaffected father'. Use genotype notation Xᴬ and Xᵃ (superscript A,a) and Y consistently. Column headers paternal gametes 'Xᴬ' and 'Y'. Row headers maternal gametes 'Xᴬ' and 'Xᵃ'. Upper-left cell 'XᴬXᴬ' caption 'Non-carrier daughter'. Upper-right 'XᴬY' caption 'Unaffected son'. Lower-left 'XᴬXᵃ' caption 'Carrier daughter'. Lower-right 'XᵃY' caption 'Affected son'. Tint only carrier cell pale teal and affected cell pale ochre. Legend 'Xᵃ carries the recessive variant'. Bottom 'Each child inherits one maternal X'. No claim carriers can never have symptoms, no additional chromosome copies, no gender stereotypes.
forbiddenAnatomy: No claimed anatomical reconstruction, diagnostic image, histology or literal neuroanatomical pathway
No organ cutaways or invented internal spatial relationships

validation.sourceFacts: Checked against listed primary clinical sources during original topic review
validation.pixelChecks: Visually inspected all four combinations: XAXA, XAY, XAXa, XaY match paternal columns and maternal rows; daughter/son carrier/affected labels agree and superscripts are legible. No claim that carriers are invariably asymptomatic.
